title: RaMem: Contextual Reinstatement for Long-term Agentic Memory
title_zh: RaMem：面向长期智能体记忆的上下文重建
abstract_en: Long-term memory has become increasingly important for LLM agents that operate across extended interactions and evolving task contexts. Recent memory systems have made past experiences more persistent, compact, and retrievable, but retrieval alone does not ensure that a memory provides valid evidence for the current query. When experiences are compressed into reusable fragments, memories from different situations may appear equally relevant if they involve recurring entities or user states. We refer to this failure as context collapse: memories lose the surrounding context needed to judge whether they provide valid evidence for the current query. To address this problem, we propose Contextual Reinstatement for Agentic Memory (RaMem), a framework that turns retrieved memory fragments into contextually verifiable evidence. RaMem operates through four coordinated stages: (i) evidence anchoring grounds each memory in its original episodic conditions, especially event time, mention time, session span, and participants; (ii) recall condition induction derives the evidence conditions implied by the query; (iii) validity-aware retrieval uses these conditions to prioritize context-compatible memories while retaining content-relevant candidates as fallback evidence; and (iv) context-preserved synthesis keeps the selected memories' structured context available to the generator. Experiments on long-term memory benchmarks show that RaMem consistently improves performance over strong memory baselines, with average F1 gains of more than 10% across several backbones.
abstract_zh: 长期记忆对于需要跨越长程交互和动态任务上下文运行的 LLM agents 越来越重要。已有记忆系统提升了过往经验的持久性、压缩性和可检索性，但单纯检索并不能保证某段记忆能为当前查询提供有效证据。当经验被压缩为可复用片段时，来自不同情境的记忆可能因包含相同实体或用户状态而显得同样相关。论文将这一问题称为 context collapse，即记忆丢失了判断其是否适用于当前查询所需的周边上下文。为此，作者提出 Contextual Reinstatement for Agentic Memory（RaMem），将检索到的记忆片段转化为可进行上下文验证的证据。RaMem 包含四个阶段：evidence anchoring 将每条记忆锚定到原始情节条件，如事件时间、提及时间、会话跨度和参与者；recall condition induction 从查询中推导所需证据条件；validity-aware retrieval 基于这些条件优先选择上下文兼容的记忆，同时保留内容相关候选作为备选证据；context-preserved synthesis 在生成阶段保留结构化上下文。长期记忆基准实验表明，RaMem 相比强记忆基线稳定提升性能，在多个 backbone 上平均 F1 提升超过 10%。
key_points_zh: 提出 context collapse 问题：压缩后的记忆片段可能因共享实体或状态而被误判为相关，但缺少原始情境来判断证据有效性。
RaMem 通过 Contextual Reinstatement 将检索记忆转化为带有时间、会话跨度、参与者等结构化上下文的可验证证据。
方法包含四步：evidence anchoring、recall condition induction、validity-aware retrieval 和 context-preserved synthesis。
validity-aware retrieval 不只看内容相似度，还根据查询隐含的证据条件筛选上下文兼容记忆，并保留相关候选作为 fallback。
在长期记忆 benchmarks 上，RaMem 相比强基线在多个 LLM backbones 上取得稳定提升，平均 F1 增益超过 10%。

llm_assessment.comment: RaMem is a strong agent-memory infrastructure contribution that improves contextual validity and retrieval reliability for long-running agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: RaMem 是一项较强的智能体记忆基础设施贡献，提升了长期智能体的上下文有效性与检索可靠性。
